messages:
alex.chen: hey team, first-day snag. Migrated from my old MBP to the new company M2 Air and Migration Assistant errors out: "Could not mount encrypted user volume (error -69545)". FileVault enabled on old device. Need SSH keys + Keychain items moved too. Do I need to turn off FileVault? Can IT push a temp admin instead?

it_helpdesk: welcome @alex.chen :wave: we can help. Quick checks: what macOS versions on old and new machines? Also paste the output lines for `diskutil apfs list` and `fdesetup status` (no secrets).

alex.chen: old mac: macOS 12.6.8, new: macOS 13.5.1. diskutil snippet:
```
/dev/disk1 (synthesized):
   APFS Container Scheme - Physical Store disk0s2
   +-> Physical Store disk0s2

   APFS Volume disk1s1 - Container disk1 (Encrypted)
   APFS Volume disk1s2 - Data
```
`fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is On."

mdm-bot: MDM: enrollment profile pushed at 2024-09-03T15:22:10Z. Profile installed; compliance pending until device migration completes.

it_helpdesk: Plan A (least invasive): create a temporary local admin account on the new Mac, run Migration Assistant to that admin, then use sudo to move files into your enterprise account. Steps:
1) System Settings > Users & Groups > Add user (Admin).
2) On old Mac: Migration Assistant -> To another Mac. On new Mac: Migration Assistant -> From a Mac. Pick the temp admin as destination.
3) After migration, log into your normal enterprise account, then from temp admin run: `sudo chown -R alex.chen /Users/alex.chen` and fix SSH perms `chmod 700 ~/.ssh && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_rsa`.
Notes: avoid copying Keychain files raw; use Keychain Access app (File > Import Items) to import exported items.

jordan_devops: for SSH, simplest is encrypted external drive + rsync: `rsync -a --progress ~/.ssh /Volumes/Encrypted/` then reverse on new mac. After copy: `chmod 700 ~/.ssh && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/*` and `ssh-add -K ~/.ssh/id_rsa` to store passphrase. If you don't have a company encrypted USB, IT can provide one.

it_helpdesk: corporate policy: do not export corporate secrets to personal cloud storage. We can instead push a one-time `temp-admin-2h` MDM profile so you don't have to create local admin manually. Want us to push it?

claire_w: welcome @alex.chen! Ping me if you need repo access after keys are restored.

alex.chen: yes please push the temp admin. thanks :slightly_smiling_face:

it_helpdesk: pushed `temp-admin-2h` at 2024-09-03T15:27:05Z. You'll get Okta secure message with the temp admin username. That account expires automatically after 2 hours.

mdm-bot: MDM: device compliance updated at 2024-09-03T15:30:35Z. Status: compliant.

alex.chen: migration completed under temp admin. Used rsync to copy `~/.ssh` from old machine onto company-encrypted USB, then imported keychain items via Keychain Access, fixed ownership and perms, and re-added keys with `ssh-add -K`. FileVault remained enabled and I can log in to my enterprise account. All good now :tada:

it_helpdesk: great news. Temp admin will auto-revoke at the 2-hour mark. If you run into VPN cert or SSO keychain issues, reopen this thread or DM IT.

alex.chen: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick help :heart:
